name: Filter Panel
summary: Adaptive multi-group filter form that uses one canonical control tree as an adjacent panel in wide containers and inside canonical Drawer in constrained containers, with immediate or manual target-owned query commitment.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named adaptive filter boundary and inline-size query owner; it is not a navigation landmark or result form.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Canonical Button that opens the constrained Drawer surface and is omitted from the wide panel flow.

anatomy.name: active
anatomy.description: Native list of committed active values composed from canonical Tags.

anatomy.name: activeItem
anatomy.description: Native list item containing one canonical Tag and its optional target-owned removal request.

anatomy.name: layout
anatomy.description: Container-responsive parent that places one filter surface beside one target result slot when wide.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Canonical Drawer overlay used only while the constrained modal surface is open.

anatomy.name: surface
anatomy.description: One canonical Drawer root that becomes a non-modal adjacent panel in wide containers without duplicating the form or controls.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Visible panel title and constrained-surface canonical Close Button.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Single named native GET form shared by both adaptive presentations; results remain outside it.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Scrollable Drawer body and wide panel content region containing always-visible labelled groups.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: Native fieldset for one always-visible target facet group.

anatomy.name: groupTitle
anatomy.description: First legend supplying the visible and accessible group label; it is not a disclosure trigger.

anatomy.name: groupOptions
anatomy.description: Canonical Checkbox or Radio choices with real target names, values, availability and checked state.

anatomy.name: priceRange
anatomy.description: Target-specific bounded minimum/maximum composition using canonical numeric Inputs when the facet source supplies a real price range.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Manual-mode canonical Apply and Cancel actions; absent in Immediate mode.

anatomy.name: results
anatomy.description: Target-owned associated result composition kept outside the filter form.

variants.name: immediate
variants.description: Every canonical choice change is a committed query-change request; the target owns URL/history and result coordination.

variants.name: manual
variants.description: Choices edit target-owned draft values; Apply commits and Cancel restores the last committed projection without changing the URL.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One density that responds to the owning container: adjacent panel when coherent, canonical Drawer when constrained.

states.name: widePanel
states.description: One non-modal adjacent panel with the trigger and close action unavailable.

states.name: drawerClosed
states.description: Constrained surface is unavailable and the named trigger is present.

states.name: drawerOpen
states.description: Canonical modal Drawer with visible close action, contained focus and background exclusion owned by the adapter.

states.name: withActiveFilters
states.description: One or more committed values projected as canonical Tags in a native list.

states.name: manualDraft
states.description: Draft choice values and visible Apply/Cancel actions exist without mutating the committed query until Apply.

behavior.name: nativeQueryForm
behavior.description: Web exposes one named native GET form and successful values. Product cards and other consumer forms remain in the sibling results slot.

behavior.name: adaptiveSurface
behavior.description: One control tree is composed as a non-modal adjacent panel when its container is wide and as canonical modal Drawer when constrained. Adapters must not duplicate desktop/mobile forms or use viewport width as the sole switch.

behavior.name: commitPolicy
behavior.description: Immediate is the default committed-change request. Manual mode maintains one target-owned draft projection; Apply requests the committed query and Cancel restores committed values without URL mutation.

behavior.name: nativeGroups
behavior.description: V1 groups remain visible and use canonical named Checkbox or Radio controls; a source-backed price facet may compose bounded canonical numeric Inputs. No disclosure state or inert title Button is introduced.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
behavior.description: Native Web controls own current form values; controlled adapters project coherent committed and, only in Manual mode, draft collections without a hidden duplicate owner.

behavior.name: activeFilterRemoval
behavior.description: A canonical Tag action requests removal of one committed value. The target reconciles query/results, chooses surviving focus and announces meaningful change.

behavior.name: resultCoordination
behavior.description: The target owns query-parameter names and serialization, push-versus-replace history, Back/Forward synchronization, cancellation, pending/error/empty status, result replacement, focus, analytics and pagination reset.

behavior.name: progressiveBaseline
behavior.description: Without enhancement, the native GET form remains inline and usable. Enhancement may activate Drawer presentation and immediate result updates without removing native form semantics.

behavior.name: dependencyComposition
behavior.description: Filter Panel consumes canonical Drawer, Button, Tag, Checkbox, Radio and Input behavior rather than copying their visual or interaction systems.

properties.name: commitMode
properties.description: Immediate committed-change requests or explicit Manual draft Apply/Cancel lifecycle.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible localized panel title and accessible name for the single native filter form.

properties.name: formAction
properties.description: Real Web GET destination supplied by the owning target; neutral source does not define query keys or serialization.

properties.name: triggerLabel
properties.description: Visible localized canonical Button label that opens the constrained Drawer.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual localized accessible name for the constrained Drawer Close Button.

properties.name: applyLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Ignored in Immediate mode; Manual mode adapters must supply a non-empty localized label.
properties.description: Visible canonical submit Button label for Manual mode.

properties.name: cancelLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Ignored in Immediate mode; Manual mode adapters must supply a non-empty localized label.
properties.description: Visible canonical Button label restoring committed values in Manual mode.

properties.name: activeFiltersLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the active-filter list when no committed values are present.
properties.description: Localized accessible name for the native list of committed active Tags.

properties.name: activeFilters
properties.description: Ordered committed-value list composed from canonical Tags; the target owns removal results and focus.

properties.name: filterGroups
properties.description: Zero or more always-visible native fieldsets composed from canonical named Checkbox, Radio or source-backed bounded numeric Input controls.

properties.name: results
properties.description: Associated target-owned result composition outside the filter form; Filter Panel owns only adaptive adjacency.

accessibility: Render one non-empty visible panel title and use it to name the single native GET form and constrained Drawer.
Keep the same form and controls in both adaptive surfaces. Never render duplicate desktop/mobile control trees or preserve two checked-state owners.
In constrained mode compose canonical modal Drawer semantics, named trigger and dismiss action, Escape/backdrop policy, focus containment, background exclusion, scroll lock and trigger restoration.
In wide mode remove modal semantics, keep the panel in document flow and make constrained-only trigger and dismiss actions unavailable.
Keep result content outside the filter form so consumer forms remain valid and all stale result focus stops can be replaced atomically.
Group related controls with fieldset and a first legend. V1 group titles are never disclosure buttons.
Give every choice a stable target-defined name and value and preserve canonical Checkbox, Radio or bounded numeric Input keyboard, checked/value, disabled and form behavior.
Render committed active values as a named native list of canonical Tags and let the target own removal reconciliation, focus and status.
In Manual mode expose complete localized Apply and Cancel actions and restore committed values on Cancel without changing the URL.
Use one target-owned result status and preserve query parameters, Back/Forward history, focus, pagination reset, loading/error/empty truth and analytics outside neutral Filter Panel.
Preserve long/localized labels, unbroken content, RTL, text spacing, 200 percent zoom, forced-color focus and reduced motion through canonical dependencies.

web.notes: One native GET form progressively composes as a container-driven adjacent panel or canonical Drawer; the adapter owns only surface lifecycle and emits native choice/submit requests while the target owns query/results.

shopify.notes: Main Collection maps collection.filters names, values, counts and active-removal URLs into the same GET form and adaptive surface; native navigation preserves linkable query state while enhanced section refresh remains target-owned.

react.notes: The first-party docs target renders one form tree with controlled committed/draft projections and canonical Drawer lifecycle.

swiftui.notes: Map one selection model into an adjacent inspector or modal sheet according to container/navigation context.

compose.notes: Map one selection model into an adjacent panel or modal sheet according to container/navigation context.
